'''''Calyptocarpus vialis''''' is a [[species]] of flowering plant in the family [[Asteraceae]]. Common names for ''C. vialis'' include '''straggler daisy''', '''horseherb''', '''lawnflower''',<ref name=lbj/> and '''creeping Cinderella-weed'''.<ref name=grin/> It is native to south Texas, Mexico, Belize, Venezuela, and the Caribbean. It has also been introduced east of Texas, Argentina, Hawaii, India, Java, Australia, and Taiwan.<ref name=powo/> It is one of only three [[species]] in the [[genus]] ''[[Calyptocarpus]]''.<ref name=powo/>

==Description==
Its opposite leaves are typically {{cvt|1–3|cm}} long and triangular to lanceolate in shape.<ref name=fna/><ref name=fnagenus/> It bears heads of yellow flowers, with around 10–20 disc florets and three to eight [[ray floret]]s, the laminae of the latter around {{cvt|2–5|mm|abbr=on}} long. It flowers year round.<ref name=fna/> It is a weedy species, found in lawns and along other disturbed areas such as roadsides and paths.<ref name=fna/>

==Uses==
''Calyptocarpus vialis'' possesses medicinal properties that are as effective as the antibacterial drug ciprofloxacin.<ref name=":0">{{Cite journal |last=Bachhar |first=Vishwajeet |last2=Joshi |first2=Vibha |last3=Shekher Mishra |first3=Shashank |last4=Shukla |first4=Ravi K. |last5=Bhargava |first5=Samir |last6=Duseja |first6=Manisha |date=2024-09-18 |title=In‐Vitro Antimicrobial, Antidiabetic and Anticancer Activities of Calyptocarpus Vialis Extract and its Integration with Computational Studies |url=https://chemistry-europe.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1002/slct.202401414 |journal=ChemistrySelect |language=en |volume=9 |issue=35 |doi=10.1002/slct.202401414 |issn=2365-6549|url-access=subscription }}</ref> Additionally, ''C. vialis'' extracts are more effective against fungal stains than the standard market drug.<ref name=":0" /> With further research and development, ''C. vialis'' could be crucial in developing medications for various diseases.<ref name=":0" />
